restoration_note: Teaching 66 reads the sun's daily rising and setting as a double sign of the Third Ambassador: dawn rehearses the First Man's primal shining that drove the sons of Darkness from their storehouses and broke the body of their Five Sons; dusk rehearses the final Extraction in which the last Andrias gathers all Light into the Pleroma while Death and the deniers are shut into the sunless night (the bolos). Most gaps are tightly constrained letter-completions of standard Lycopolitan formulas (conjunctives ⲛ̄ⲧⲉⲧⲛ̄-/ⲛϥ̄-, genitive linkers, ⲧⲁⲙⲓⲟⲛ, ⲛ̄ⲧⲟⲩⲛⲟⲩ, ⲧⲙⲛ̄ⲧⲛⲁⲟ̄, ⲍⲙ̄), and the editor's proposals fit the spiritual arc cleanly. Three larger restorations (sleep ⲫⲓⲛⲏⲃ at sunrise, "outer body" ⲉⲧϩⲓⲃⲁⲗ for the archonic body, ⲁⲡⲁⲓⲱⲛ ⲙ̄(ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ) for the upward gathering, and ⲛⲁⲣⲛⲏⲧⲏⲥ for the deniers paired with blasphemers) are confirmed by the spiritual reading. Gap {1} is the only weakly anchored fill, where only the article ⲡⲉ is editorially preserved.

restorations.basis: Conjunctive prefix ⲛ̄ⲧⲉⲧⲛ̄- (2pl) with the verbal stem ⲙ̄ⲙⲉ 'know' that follows; standard hortatory continuation 'so that you may know in the manner being manifested to you.' Editor proposal confirmed by Lycopolitan grammar.

Editor preserves only article ⲡⲉ-; ϣⲁ- 'until' requires a temporal noun, and the parallel later in the chapter (ⲡⲥⲏⲩ ⲉⲧⲉⲣⲉ) suggests 'until the time/hour' (ⲡⲉⲩⲛⲉⲩ / ⲡⲉⲡⲛⲁⲩ). Only the article-fragment is certain.

Sunrise context: creatures of flesh emerge at dawn 'out of [the sleep]' in which they had been hidden; ⲫⲓⲛⲏⲃ = ⲡ-ⲉⲛⲏⲃ 'the sleep.' Spiritual register fits the Living Soul's nightly concealment ended by the Ambassador's shining.
Lycopolitan conjunctive ⲛϥ- continuing the future ⲛⲁⲡⲣ̄ⲓⲉ: 'the sun shall shine and (shall) be manifested forth.' The verb ⲱⲛϩ̄ visible after the gap completes the parallelism.
Single-letter completion of genitive linker ⲛ̄ⲧ[ⲉ] before ⲧⲙⲛ̄ⲧⲣⲱⲙⲉ on the next line: 'their mouths, of all humanity.'
Single-letter completion of ⲡⲕⲁ[ϩ] 'the earth' as goal of the motion verb ⲉⲓ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ⲁ-: 'creatures come forth onto the earth.' Earth as natural mind / ground of natural life (lexicon).
Standard prepositional construction ϩ[ⲛ̄ ⲟⲩ]ⲕⲁⲣⲁⲓ̈ⲧⲩ̄ 'in a stillness'; the Cross of Light 'stands fast in stillness' as locus of the daily exposure of the Living Soul.
Genitive linker ⲙ̄ⲡϣⲁⲣⲡ̄ [ⲛ̄]ⲣⲱⲙⲉ 'of the First Man' — the cosmological figure (Divine Truth descending into the natural) is named explicitly in the spiritual reading as the referent of sunrise.
Single-letter completion of ⲛ̄ⲧⲙⲛ̄[ⲧ]ⲛⲁⲟ̄ 'from the Greatness'; the lexicon fixes ⲧⲙⲛ̄ⲧⲛⲁⲟ̄ as the inmost realm of the Father from which the First Man's attributes proceeded.
Two-letter completion of ⲛ̄ⲧⲟⲩⲛ[ⲟⲩ] 'in (that) hour,' the temporal anchor that opens the next line ⲉⲧⲙⲙⲉⲩ 'that very (hour).'

Single-letter completion of ⲛⲟⲩⲧⲁⲙ[ⲓ]ⲟⲛ 'their storehouses,' continuing onto next line ⲟⲛ. Lexicon-fixed: storehouse = inner repositories; here, of darkness — sons of Darkness expelled from their false storehouses at the First Man's shining.
ⲛⲟⲩⲃⲏ[ⲃ ⲛ̄ⲥⲱⲩ] 'their cavern behind them' — ⲃⲏⲃ ('cave/hole') paralleling ⲙⲁⲛϩⲱⲡ 'hiding-place' from the sunset image; the sons of Darkness 'leave behind' their dwellings as the light pours in.

ⲡⲥⲱⲙⲁ ⲉⲧ[ϩⲓⲃⲁⲗ] 'the outer body' — Manichaean term for the external archonic carapace. The reading describes the breaking of 'the body of the Five Sons' (the five forms of self-love mounted upon the receptive natural) at the First Man's shining.

ⲡⲉ[ⲩⲥ]ⲱ[ⲙⲁ ϩⲙ̄ ⲡ] 'their body, in the [war/cosmos]' — the Five Sons of the King of Darkness 'mounted upon their body' continued from the previous line; restoration completes the standard cosmological formula. Following page would specify ⲡⲡⲟⲗⲉⲙⲟⲥ or ⲡⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ.
Lycopolitan relative converter ⲉⲧⲉⲣⲉ; only middle letter ⲣ bracketed by editor. Standard syntax linking 'The Election itself, in which the sun shall be chosen forth out of the cosmos.'

Editor restores final 3sg.m. suffix ϩ in ⲛ̄ⲍⲏⲧ[ϩ̄]; Lyc. ⲍⲏⲧϥ̄ = Sah. ϩⲏⲧϥ̄ 'his heart.' The sun is chosen forth 'with the chosen ones of his heart' — the elect gathered as the Ambassador's beloved at the consummation.
Lycopolitan ⲍⲙ̄ = Sah. ϩⲙ̄ 'in,' linking the purification clause to ⲡⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ on the next line: 'the entire Light shall be purified and chosen out [in] the cosmos.'

Completes the upward-motion clause ⲛⲁⲃⲱⲕ ⲁⲍⲣⲏⲓ̈ ⲁⲡⲁⲓⲱⲛ ⲙ̄[ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ] 'shall go upward to the Aeon of Light.' Lexicon-fixed: aeon = state of divine love and wisdom; the last Andrias's homeward gathering.

Editor restores initial ⲧ; ⲧⲙ̄- (privative) + ⲡⲣⲉ/ⲡⲣⲏ ('sun') = 'the sunless [region],' parallel to ⲧⲟⲩⲱⲏ ⲛ̄ⲕⲉⲕⲉ later in the line. Spiritual reading fixes this as the bolos / tomb where Death and the deniers are sealed at the consummation.

Editor restores middle ⲛⲏ in ⲛⲁⲣ[ⲛⲏ]ⲧⲏⲥ; Greek loanword ἀρνητής 'denier, repudiator,' standard Manichaean polemical term paired with ⲛ̄ⲣⲉϩⲭⲓⲟⲩⲁ 'blasphemers' in the next line — those bound to Death at the final judgment.
Editor restores final 3pl. suffix ⲩ in ⲁⲭⲱ[ⲩ]; Lyc. ⲁⲭⲱⲩ = Sah. ⲉϫⲱⲟⲩ 'upon them.' Idiom ϣⲱⲡⲉ + ⲉϫⲱ⸗ = 'befall, happen upon them' — the sunless night sealing on Death and his deniers.
